title: West Bengal Launches 'PMCSPY' ₹313.30 Crore Special Package for Tea Garden Workers
summary: Allocates ₹177 crore for Cha Shramik Shiksha and constructs 321 modern resting sheds.

blocks.content: Allocates ₹177 crore for Cha Shramik Shiksha and constructs 321 modern resting sheds.

items: Package Outlay: ₹313.30 crore special assistance package under Pradhan Mantri Cha Shramik Protsahan Yojana.
Three Pillars: Cha Shramik Shiksha Yojana (₹177 cr), Swasthya Suraksha (₹72 cr), and Aashray Yojana (₹63 cr for 321 resting sheds).

blocks.title: Static Background & GK Context
blocks.summary: Nodal Agency: North Bengal Development Department (NBDD).

blocks.title: Exam Trap & Statutory Distinction
blocks.content: Education allocation (₹177 cr) vs healthcare (₹72 cr) vs resting sheds (₹63 cr).
